# Mastory

> Educational apps ecosystem for kids and families — storytelling, gaming, music, video, and homework help.

Mastory is a portfolio of safe, age-appropriate, COPPA-compliant apps designed for children ages 3–12 and their parents. Our mission: "We build the world, you fill it with stories."

## Pages
- [Home](https://mastory.co/): Overview of the Mastory ecosystem and featured apps.
- [About](https://mastory.co/about): Company mission, team, and approach to children's learning.
- [Blog](https://mastory.co/blog): Articles on parenting, education, and children's technology.
- [Contact](https://mastory.co/contact): Get in touch with the Mastory team.
- [Privacy](https://mastory.co/privacy): How we handle data, with focus on child safety and COPPA compliance.
- [Terms](https://mastory.co/terms): Terms of service.

## Products
- [Mastory Reading](https://read.mastory.co): Personalized AI storytelling app for kids (iOS, Android).
- [Mastory Gaming](https://gaming.mastory.co): Single and multiplayer games with integrated learning.
- [Mastory Shop](https://shop.mastory.co): Marketplace for educational products and resources.
- [Mastory Music](https://music.mastory.co): Music creation and curated playlists for kids.
- [Mastory Video](https://video.mastory.co): Educational video focused on meaningful engagement.
- [Mastory Assistant](https://assistant.mastory.co): Homework help and learning companion.
